assets.prompt: Create a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture, 1024x1024, for a game UI background. Use the attached concept's starry void as the reference. STYLE: SEVERED HEAVEN, GILDED VOID. Deep void black #040507 with a very quiet cosmic sky: sparse fine stars and faint dark nebula, never behind text. Panels are obsidian, near-black with a subtle lacquer sheen, framed in antique gold filigree #d9b46a: fine double rules, cloud-scroll and fretwork corners, small gold diamond studs. Qi is a muted cyan light #7fc7d9, used sparingly, like light leaking through hairline cracks. Warm ivory #e9e5da type, a refined serif display face with small brush hanzi beside English. Painted Chinese fantasy game art: rich detail in the ornament, calm restrained lighting, no neon, no glow haze over panels. Straight-on, orthographic, no perspective, no device frame, no watermark. Texture: the void sky, sparse fine stars of a few sizes, a handful slightly warm, and the faintest deep blue-black nebula wisps, very dark overall. It must tile on all four sides with no visible seam: even density everywhere, no focal point, no vignette, no border, no moon, no constellation lines, no text.

Template E, with docs/mockups/cultivate-scene-guide.png as the layout guide. Create a landscape 1536x1024 illustration AS AN ASSET, placed behind real HTML text and buttons. Use the first attached concept's mood and palette as the reference, and the second attached image as an exact LAYOUT GUIDE (do not draw the guide's flat colors or blocks). STYLE: SEVERED HEAVEN, GILDED VOID. Deep void black #040507 with a very quiet cosmic sky: sparse fine stars and faint dark nebula, never behind text. Panels are obsidian, near-black with a subtle lacquer sheen, framed in antique gold filigree #d9b46a: fine double rules, cloud-scroll and fretwork corners, small gold diamond studs. Qi is a muted cyan light #7fc7d9, used sparingly, like light leaking through hairline cracks. Warm ivory #e9e5da type, a refined serif display face with small brush hanzi beside English. Painted Chinese fantasy game art: rich detail in the ornament, calm restrained lighting, no neon, no glow haze over panels. Straight-on, orthographic, no perspective, no device frame, no watermark. Scene: a cultivator's cave abode, a hall carved into a mountain cliff. Straight ahead, behind the seat, a wide natural cave mouth opens onto misty peaks and a quiet starry void sky. On a floor of dark polished stone that faintly reflects, a low round stone dais with a worn meditation mat sits exactly where the guide's olive ellipse is: centred horizontally, its center about 66% down from the top. On it sits a cultivator cross-legged, painted as a pure featureless deep-black silhouette that fills exactly the guide's grey seated shape, same size and outline: no face, no clothing detail, no glow, only its soft dark reflection in the floor below it. A few dim lanterns low on the side walls, shelves of scrolls in the rock, a small incense burner. Light: soft, dim and even, as if from the cave mouth's starlight; NO visible sun or moon, no strong cast shadows on the floor, so code can add the hour's sunlight later. Keep clear: the area around the figure plain and dark so small glowing particles read over it; the top strip (guide's top bar) quiet; everything in the guide's bottom brown band is dark shadowed floor with little detail. The left and right edges fall off into darkness. No other people, no creatures. Full-bleed, no frame, no sidebars. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO UI, NO symbols, no watermark.

The fog's cloud banks (A5, docs/mockups/map-fog/): a sheet of eight separate soft cloud banks, two across and four down, each centred in its cell with dark space round it, on pure black #000000, as seen from high above a painted fantasy world map at night: pale moonlit grey-white, soft billowing edges thinning to wisps, no hard outlines. The map reads each cloud's brightness as its alpha. No land, no text, no frame.

Create a sprite sheet AS AN ASSET, 1536x1024: 8 separate map landmarks on a TRANSPARENT background, on an even 4x2 grid of 384x512 cells, each landmark centred left to right in its cell with its base in the lower third, a clear margin all round, none touching. They will stand on the attached painted world map as small pieces at the places they mark: match its high, tilted view (about 50 degrees, like a carved relief model), its scale of detail, its palette and its moonlit light exactly. Painted Chinese xianxia fantasy game art, night-dark and moonlit, desaturated: slate and blue-grey stone, deep pine green, muted ochre and umber earth, soft mist; calm light from the upper left, a faint cool rim of starlight, warm lantern points only on buildings, antique gold only as small accents on roofs and gates. Each stands on a small irregular patch of its own ground (earth, rock, a few trees) that fades out softly at its edges so it settles into the land beneath. Nothing touches the edge of its cell. No text, no labels, no symbols, no roads leading away, no people, no frame, no grid lines, no background, no cast shadow outside its own patch of ground. Left to right, top to bottom: 1. a frontier village: a dozen low tiled roofs round a well inside a stockade of stakes, one warm light; 2. a checkpoint: a timber and stone gate tower straddling a short stretch of road, a low wall either side, one banner; 3. a cave mouth in a rock face, dark inside, a faint path up to it, a pine leaning over it; 4. a beast den: a hollow under tumbled boulders, gnawed bones at its mouth, claw-scored rock; 5. a ruin: broken walls and a fallen pavilion roof overgrown with vines, a cracked stone stair; 6. a wayside shrine: a small tiled shrine with an incense burner and two stone lanterns under an old pine; 7. a camp: a few hide tents round a fire pit, a drying rack, a picket line; 8. old graves: a cluster of grass-grown burial mounds with weathered stone tablets and a dead tree.
